finding: The control of the re-sent checkout pass: get_order, sent anonymously to one merchant's UCP endpoint with the same arguments that let create_checkout through to merchandise validation one second earlier, is refused with HTTP 403 and JSON-RPC error -32000 AuthenticationRequired, 'A valid JWT is required to call get_order', pointing at the vendor's authentication page. The arguments were a checkout body no get_order could use, and the refusal names the tool and not them, so the gate sits before argument validation for this tool and after it, or nowhere, for create_checkout. That is the same split the 2026-09-20 pass measured and the 2026-09-29 thirteen-tool pass confirmed, where get_order and complete_checkout were the two tools refused by name. One small difference between the two statuses on this day: the 200s carry an x-shopify-ucp-mcp-api-version header and the 403 does not. Whether the JWT is available to an anonymous registrant is not measured.
